rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something extremely bad or awful.

example.english: The food at this restaurant is really appalling.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食真係差勁。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 caa1 ging6

rows.note: Use this when the appalling thing is outrageously bad, excessive, or shocking, such as a waste of money.

example.english: The government spending so much money building this unused bridge is appalling.
example.traditional: 政府用咁多錢起呢座冇人用嘅橋，真係離譜。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 jung6 gam3 do1 cin4 hei2 ne1 zo6 mou5 jan4 jung6 ge3 kiu4 zan1 hai6 lei4 pou2

rows.note: Use this when appalling means genuinely horrifying or frightening rather than merely very bad.

example.english: The murder scenes in that horror film last night were genuinely appalling.
example.traditional: 噚晚套恐怖片啲殺人場面真係恐怖。
example.jyutping: cam4 maan5 tou3 hung2 bou3 pin3 di1 saat3 jan4 coeng4 min2 zan1 hai6 hung2 bou3
